column1: # Tetris Effect: Connected, SDK 13 (nnSdk-13_3_2), Unreal Engine 4.27 (see README.md for what was measured on it)
# Unreal 4.27: nninitStartup reserves the profile's address region (game_args, MB) and the engine's own allocations fill it; at
# 2048 the window (base..base+0x80000000) was at 100.7% by frame 300 and the next 16 MB request aborted with Unreal's
# "Ran out of memory allocating %llu bytes" (the number printed is the window span, not the request). 3072 is the next whole-GB
# value the engine accepts (2304 died in nninitStartup). Its own AllocateAddressRegion(0xfe000000) needs an alias wider than
# 4 GB beside the SDK's node area: 4 GB failed at init, 4.0625 GB works. The block is reserve + 1 GB of alignment slack against
# iOS's 6 GB reservation cap, so 4.875 GB is the widest that still signs and runs on a phone (5.5 GB dies in mem_init).
# The FMallocBinned3 cut and the host allocator are in patches.py / hle_uemalloc.c. See docs/reference/memory.md, and check a
# profile's budget with python3 dm/tools/check_memory.py <title id>.
# the NPDM declares 80 MB of system resource
# the decoded shader code archives: the engine's global shaders and the game's material shaders
